svg.title: Boss fight: the risks as friendly monsters
svg.desc: Seven pixel monsters on name plates with HP bars: The Hallucinator, a floating eyeball with a swirly iris and little wings, two impossible cubes drift beside it; The Leaker, a dripping bucket with a document sticking out, drops leaking from its holes; The Key Goblin, a green goblin hugging a bundle of keys; The Licence Lich, a skeleton in a plum robe holding a scroll marked with a copyright sign; The Orphan Golem, an abandoned grey robot covered in cobwebs, one eye flickering, a spider dangling; The Lock-in Dragon, a green dragon coiled around a big padlock, puffing a tiny flame; The Brain Drain, a brain sinking into a sink while the drain swirls.
